Results.ReviewText: First time grill owner, have had Weber charcoal grills. We are a family of 4 and needed something that was enough for all of us and yet not break the bank. As much as I lust after the more expensive lines, this was a good "starter" grill that meets our needs. We had the option for it to be put together for us before delivery, which I highly recommend if you are a city slicker like ourselves. I also recommend getting the cover, so you don't have to drag the thing in/out of your garage and can instead wrap it up with the cover during the summer months where you get more use of it. Lastly, the gas tank purchase was also helpful and cheaper to get it filled at your local nursery.

Results.ReviewText: After spending weeks looking at propane grills I decided on the Weber Spirit ii e-310. The choice was the right choice. To start, my in laws just bought a new Weber after having their previous one for over 15 years!!! I went with this one because of budget and the size of my household. Two of us and a cat. Anyway, I've owned and operated all sorts of grills in many different conditions. This is by far a great grill. It's simple, looks great when you take the cover off and fires up right away. There are 6 hooks for utensils and cleaning gear which is a major plus. The shelf is perfect for whatever you need to storage underneath a grill. I do like the propane gas full/empty indicator. Hint....the battery for the ignition is underneath to the right. I did not assemble the grill so I can't attest to how long it should take someone or how easy it is. Over 5,000 reviews for this grill is impressive. Great job Weber!
Results.Title: Bone in or not Bone in

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
